simple.meaning: מַפֶּלֶת (mappeleth) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “fall , i.e. decadence ; concretely, a ruin ; specifically a carcase.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 14:8. The surrounding context includes land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַפֶּלֶת (H4658) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

timeline.evidenceText: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.
When the wicked increase, sin increases;
“The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?
Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall.
All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches;

I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol† Sheol is the place of the dead. with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.
Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you,

definitions.full: H4658. mappeleth מַמֶּ֫לֶת noun feminine carcass, ruin, overthrow ; — 1 carcass , of lion, ׳מ construct Judg 14:8 . 2 elsewhere suffix a. a ruin , מַמַּלְתּוֺ Ezek 31:13 (kg. under figure of tree). b. overthrow, id. Ezek 31:16 (same figurative); מַמַּלְתֶּ֑ךָ (kg.) 32:10 ; מַמַּלְתֵּךְ of Tyre) 26:15 , 18 ; 27:27 ; מַמַּלְתָּם (of wicked) Prov 29:16 .
